title: Fix post-archive pre-merge ownership convergence
outOfScope: Rewriting or deleting #709's immutable archive, Outcome, manifest, or existing PR evidence.
Lowering the declared coverage floor, bypassing ai-pre-merge, merging #738, or changing provider required checks.
Unrelated Issue reconciliation, release publication, and broad worktree cleanup.

sources.reason: Authoritative corrective Issue with the reproduced #709 post-archive pre-merge failure.
Immutable source Summary whose generated start/report evidence must be recognized precisely.
No-active ownership classifier used by ai-pre-merge.
Existing recovery admission boundary that correctly rejects check-ai-pr-passing candidates.

riskAssessment.reason: A false ownership allowance could permit unrelated archive evidence; a false rejection blocks a completed Work Item. Coverage comparison must remain strict without floating-point ambiguity.

reasons: Archived evidence and merge-gate behavior require strict verification.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized automatic governed execution; #739 provides the bounded corrective authority.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A completed archive transaction grants no-active pre-merge ownership only to its exact manifest/Summary-bound generated start receipt and Human Benefit Report paths.
Unrelated, historical, malformed, or mismatched generated evidence remains unowned and fails closed.
The declared 85.10 percent coverage floor is compared deterministically without lowering the policy or accepting a below-floor rounded display.
Executable regressions reproduce #709's post-archive candidate and prove both check-ai-pr and ai-pre-merge converge without an archive rewrite or bypass.
Lifecycle documentation and generated capability projections describe the corrected post-archive boundary.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: #709's archived candidate passes check-ai-pr and all hosted checks but ai-pre-merge rejects its generated start receipt and Human Benefit Report as unowned; the existing same-Work-Item recovery route cannot open because its admission audit passes.
constraints: Use Issue #739 and the user's standing direction recorded in this Contract; do not bypass or merge #738 while the gate is red.
Treat #709 archive evidence as immutable and repair the generic lifecycle behavior from current main.
Keep ownership fail-closed outside the exact current archive transaction and do not reduce the coverage floor.
intent.rationale: A precise archive-transaction binding restores legitimate lifecycle progress while preserving evidence integrity and makes the current #709 delivery mergeable through normal gates.
